name: Sengoku Renka Monogatari
source:
The love story of a certain princess not recorded in the history books. It is a time of dynasties at war. Nobunaga's niece, the youngest of the Azai Family's three daughters, is due to be married. She will not accept this fate. She flees, and meets a military commander called Maeda, the Uesugi legacy's minister Naoe, and mixed race doctor Chris on the way to the castle of Hideyoshi on the borderlands. 

As they travel, tender thoughts begin to sprout. But a dark cloud also hovers over them... Who will you fall in love with? Will you reach the borderlands? A fascinating and somewhat heartbreaking tale lost to the old kingdoms begins here... 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/eng/work/=/product_id/RE141285.html]DLSite English[/url]]
translation:
这是某位未被史书记录的公主的爱情故事。时代正值群雄割据、诸国交战。织田信长的侄女、浅井家三姐妹中最年幼的女儿即将出嫁。她不愿接受这样的命运，于是逃了出去。在前往边境秀吉城的路上，她遇到了名为前田的武将、上杉家臣直江，以及混血医生克里斯。

旅途中，温柔的情愫开始萌芽。但一片阴云也笼罩在他们头顶……你会爱上谁？能抵达边境吗？一段被古老王国遗忘、迷人却又略带心酸的故事，就此开始……

[来源：[url=http://www.dlsite.com/eng/work/=/product_id/RE141285.html]DLsite English[/url]]
